svg.title: Corner window arch and central H25 bar
svg.desc: Upper window elevation and bending interaction at 19 stations. The plan below shows the nominal vertical return beside a guard sleeve. Tangent intervals show where a forged head meets existing steel. The final plan and elevation show an in-plane pier cage shift and its tight bend crossing. The last plan compares a transverse U tie with the available wall width.
